45ml gin + 15ml lemon + 7.5ml maraschino + 7.5ml Crème de Violette. Shake. Coupe.
Color pale blue/lila signature. Cherry Luxardo garnish.
wiki.art.cocktails.white-lady-london.des: White Lady creado Harry MacElhone Ciro's London 1919, perfeccionado en Harry's Bar Paris.
wiki.art.cocktails.white-lady-london.his: MacElhone 1919. Refinado 1929 Paris. Craddock Savoy version 1930 estandar.
wiki.art.cocktails.white-lady-london.rec: 50ml gin + 22ml Cointreau + 22ml lemon + 1 clara. Shake hard. Coupe.
wiki.art.cocktails.white-lady-london.tip: Egg white version moderna. Clean balanceado citrus.
wiki.art.cocktails.corpse-reviver-no2.de: Corpse Reviver #2 hangover cure clásico de Harry Craddock Savoy. Gin + Cointreau + Lillet + lemon + absinthe.
wiki.art.cocktails.corpse-reviver-no2.hi: Craddock Savoy 1930. Para revive de morning hangover.
wiki.art.cocktails.corpse-reviver-no2.re: 22ml gin + 22ml Cointreau + 22ml Lillet Blanc + 22ml lemon + dash absinthe. Shake. Coupe.
wiki.art.cocktails.corpse-reviver-no2.ti: Craddock warning 'four in quick succession will un-revive the corpse'. Iguales partes 4 ingredientes.
wiki.art.cocktails.last-word-detroit.des: Last Word olvidado por décadas hasta revival Murray Stenson Zig Zag Cafe Seattle 2004.
wiki.art.cocktails.last-word-detroit.his: Origin Detroit Athletic Club Prohibition era. Recipes in Ted Saucier's Bottoms Up (1951).
wiki.art.cocktails.last-word-detroit.rec: 22ml gin + 22ml Chartreuse Green + 22ml maraschino + 22ml lime. Iguales partes. Shake. Coupe.
wiki.art.cocktails.last-word-detroit.tip: Stenson rediscovery 2004 = templo del cocktail revival. Equal parts perfectos balanceados.
wiki.art.cocktails.bijou-italian-jewel.d: Bijou cocktail llamado por la trinity gemstone — gin (diamante) + Chartreuse Green (esmeralda) + vermouth (rubí).
wiki.art.cocktails.bijou-italian-jewel.h: Harry Johnson Bartender's Manual 1900. Equal parts triplet.
wiki.art.cocktails.bijou-italian-jewel.r: 22ml gin + 22ml Chartreuse Green + 22ml sweet vermouth + dash orange bitters. Stir. Coupe.
wiki.art.cocktails.bijou-italian-jewel.t: Cherry garnish. Tres iguales gemstones visual story.
wiki.art.cocktails.rusty-nail-scottish.d: Rusty Nail = Scotch whisky + Drambuie. Cocktail británico clásico mid-century.
wiki.art.cocktails.rusty-nail-scottish.h: 1937 NYC World's Fair Scottish exhibit. Popularizado 1960s rat pack era.
wiki.art.cocktails.rusty-nail-scottish.r: 45ml Scotch + 25ml Drambuie. Build over rocks. Lemon twist.
wiki.art.cocktails.rusty-nail-scottish.t: Scotch blend o aged. Drambuie suaviza el Scotch. Frank Sinatra preferred.
wiki.art.cocktails.french-75-history.des: French 75 nombrado por French 75mm artillery gun. Cognac (origen) o gin (modern) + champagne.
wiki.art.cocktails.french-75-history.his: Harry MacElhone Paris 1915 (during WW1) supposedly invented. Standard Savoy Craddock 1930.
wiki.art.cocktails.french-75-history.rec: 30ml gin + 15ml lemon + 7.5ml simple + champagne top. Shake first 3. Flute.
wiki.art.cocktails.french-75-history.tip: Original cognac, today gin standard. Champagne cold absolute.
Sidecar inventado Paris 1920s post-WW1. Cognac + Cointreau + lemon. Daisy family template.
Disputed: MacElhone Harry's Bar Paris vs Ritz Hotel Paris. Both 1920s.
50ml cognac + 22ml Cointreau + 22ml lemon. Shake. Coupe (sugar rim optional).
Embury 8:3:2 ratio funciona. Sugar rim opcional moderno.
wiki.art.cocktails.between-the-sheets.de: Between the Sheets variant Sidecar con rum añadido. Cognac + rum + Cointreau + lemon. Suggestive name.
wiki.art.cocktails.between-the-sheets.hi: Harry's Bar Paris 1920s también. Naughty 1920s cocktail named.
wiki.art.cocktails.between-the-sheets.re: 22ml cognac + 22ml white rum + 22ml Cointreau + 22ml lemon. Shake. Coupe.
wiki.art.cocktails.between-the-sheets.ti: Equal parts. Sweeter que Sidecar regular por rum.
wiki.art.cocktails.vieux-carre-new-orlea: Vieux Carré inventado Walter Bergeron Hotel Monteleone NOLA 1937. Rye + cognac + vermouth + Bénédictine + bitters.
Hotel Monteleone Carousel Bar 1937. Bergeron creó signature NOLA cocktail.
22ml rye + 22ml cognac + 22ml sweet vermouth + 1 tsp Bénédictine + 2 dashes Peychaud's + 2 dashes Angostura. Stir.
Multi-spirit complex. Hotel Monteleone Carousel Bar visitable.
wiki.art.cocktails.final-ward-modern.des: Final Ward = Phil Ward Death & Co NYC variant del Last Word con rye + lemon. Modern classic.
wiki.art.cocktails.final-ward-modern.his: Phil Ward Death & Co 2006-2010. Variant del rediscovery Last Word.
wiki.art.cocktails.final-ward-modern.rec: 22ml rye + 22ml Green Chartreuse + 22ml maraschino + 22ml lemon. Shake. Coupe.
wiki.art.cocktails.final-ward-modern.tip: Lemon en vez de lime. Rye en vez de gin. Sour version Last Word.
wiki.art.cocktails.mary-pickford-cocktai: Mary Pickford cocktail creado en Cuba 1920s para silent film star Mary Pickford visit.
Hotel Nacional o Sevilla-Biltmore Habana 1920s. Pickford visit Cuba Prohibition era.
60ml rum blanco + 60ml piña juice + 7.5ml grenadine + 7.5ml maraschino. Shake. Coupe.
Versión clásica con grenadine real. Tropical pero refinado.
wiki.art.cocktails.bee-s-knees-prohibiti: Bee's Knees inventado Prohibition era para enmascarar bad gin con honey + lemon. Frank Meier Ritz Paris atribuido.
1920s Prohibition. Honey masks rough bathtub gin. Frank Meier Ritz Paris 1930s documentation.
60ml gin + 22ml lemon + 22ml honey syrup. Shake. Coupe. Lemon twist.
Honey syrup (honey + hot water 1:1). Era Prohibition cocktail mask. Refrescante simple.
wiki.art.cocktails.southside-history.des: Southside cocktail asociado con Chicago South Side mafia (Capone). Gin + mint + lime + sugar. Mojito sin rum.
wiki.art.cocktails.southside-history.his: Disputed: Chicago Capone South Side mafia preferred or NYC 21 Club. Mid-Prohibition.
wiki.art.cocktails.southside-history.rec: 60ml gin + 22ml lime + 22ml simple + 6 mint leaves. Shake. Coupe. Mint garnish.
wiki.art.cocktails.southside-history.tip: Gin Mojito basically. Sin soda. Lime juice fresh.
wiki.art.cocktails.ward-eight-boston.des: Ward Eight cocktail creado Locke-Ober Restaurant Boston 1898 para victoria política Ward 8 elections.
wiki.art.cocktails.ward-eight-boston.his: Locke-Ober Boston 1898. Martin Lomasney's Ward 8 election win celebration.
wiki.art.cocktails.ward-eight-boston.rec: 60ml bourbon + 15ml lemon + 15ml orange + 10ml grenadine real. Shake. Coupe.
wiki.art.cocktails.ward-eight-boston.tip: Grenadine real key — no Rose's. Pre-Prohibition cocktail clásico.
wiki.art.cocktails.boulevardier-paris.de: Boulevardier = Negroni con bourbon en vez de gin. Harry MacElhone Paris 1927.
wiki.art.cocktails.boulevardier-paris.hi: Harry's Bar Paris 1927. Erskine Gwynne 'Boulevardier' magazine founder.
wiki.art.cocktails.boulevardier-paris.re: 45ml bourbon + 30ml Campari + 30ml sweet vermouth. Stir. Coupe up o DOF.
wiki.art.cocktails.boulevardier-paris.ti: Higher bourbon ratio que Negroni 1:1:1. Rye también funciona variant.
wiki.art.cocktails.blood-and-sand-spanis: Blood and Sand cocktail nombrado por película 1922 Rudolph Valentino sobre bullfighter. Scotch + cherry + orange.
Inspirado en película Blood and Sand 1922. Standard Craddock Savoy 1930.
22ml Scotch + 22ml Cherry Heering + 22ml sweet vermouth + 22ml orange juice. Shake. Coupe.
Equal parts. Sweet Scotch cocktail. Cherry Heering original.
wiki.art.cocktails.scofflaw-cocktail.des: Scofflaw cocktail anti-Prohibition. Nombre coined 1924 Boston Herald contest para 'lawless drinker'.
wiki.art.cocktails.scofflaw-cocktail.his: Bar Harry's Bar Paris 1924 — Jock McElhone (Harry's son) creó tras Boston contest.
wiki.art.cocktails.scofflaw-cocktail.rec: 45ml rye + 30ml dry vermouth + 22ml lemon + 22ml grenadine + dash orange bitters. Shake.
wiki.art.cocktails.scofflaw-cocktail.tip: Word 'scofflaw' coined for cocktail. Pre-Prohibition gem.
wiki.art.cocktails.hanky-panky-london.de: Hanky Panky inventado por Ada Coleman American Bar Savoy London 1903 para actor Sir Charles Hawtrey.
wiki.art.cocktails.hanky-panky-london.hi: Ada Coleman Savoy 1903. Hawtrey 'something with a bit of punch'. Coleman creó con Fernet.
wiki.art.cocktails.hanky-panky-london.re: 45ml gin + 45ml sweet vermouth + 2 dashes Fernet-Branca. Stir. Coupe up. Orange.
wiki.art.cocktails.hanky-panky-london.ti: Fernet trace clave — sin él es Sweet Martini. Bartender drink por excelencia.
wiki.art.cocktails.mai-tai-original-1944: Mai Tai original Trader Vic 1944 Oakland. Recipe specific — rum + curaçao + orgeat + lime.
Trader Vic's Oakland 1944. Tahitian friend tasted: 'Maita'i roa ae!' (Tahitian 'out of this world').
30ml rum jamaicano + 30ml rum agricole + 22ml dry curaçao + 15ml orgeat + 22ml lime. Shake. Crushed ice.
Sin pineapple juice (versión moderna pop). Rum split key. Cherry + mint garnish.
wiki.art.cocktails.mai-tai-evolution.des: Mai Tai degradado de Trader Vic original a 'tourist mai tai' Hawaii con OJ + grenadine + pineapple.
wiki.art.cocktails.mai-tai-evolution.his: 1944 Trader Vic original → 1959 Royal Hawaiian Hotel tropical floor show variant → modern tourist.
wiki.art.cocktails.mai-tai-evolution.rec: Original Vic recipe vs tourist (rum + OJ + pineapple + grenadine + crushed ice).
wiki.art.cocktails.mai-tai-evolution.tip: Beachbum Berry, Martin Cate, Trader Vic descendants rescuing original. Tourist version mainstream.
wiki.art.cocktails.zombie-don-the-beachc: Zombie inventado Don the Beachcomber Hollywood 1934. Multi-rum lethal — '1 per customer' rule.
Donn Beach 1934. Receta secreta hasta Beachbum Berry decoded en 2007.
45ml rum dorado + 45ml rum dark + 30ml rum overproof 151 + Falernum + lime + grapefruit + Pernod + grenadine + Angostura.
Iconic 'no more than 2' rule. Tiki mug + mint. Servir crushed ice.
wiki.art.cocktails.pina-colada-puerto-ri: Piña Colada cocktail nacional Puerto Rico desde 1978. Ramón 'Monchito' Marrero Caribe Hilton 1954.
Monchito Caribe Hilton San Juan 1954. National drink Puerto Rico 1978.
60ml rum blanco + 90ml pineapple juice + 30ml coconut cream. Blend con hielo. Pineapple wedge.
Coco Lopez coconut cream original. Pineapple fresh juice key. Cherry garnish.
wiki.art.cocktails.pain-killer-bvi.title: Painkiller
wiki.art.cocktails.pain-killer-bvi.descr: Painkiller creado Soggy Dollar Bar Jost Van Dyke BVI 1971. Pusser's rum signature.
wiki.art.cocktails.pain-killer-bvi.histo: Daphne Henderson Soggy Dollar BVI 1971. Pusser's rum oficial 1989.
wiki.art.cocktails.pain-killer-bvi.recip: 60ml Pusser's rum + 120ml pineapple juice + 60ml orange juice + 30ml coconut cream. Blend o shake.
wiki.art.cocktails.pain-killer-bvi.tips: Nutmeg encima fresh grated signature. Pusser's rum auténtico key.
Jungle Bird inventado Hilton Kuala Lumpur 1978 para welcome drinks hotel. Campari + rum.
Hilton KL 1978. Único Tiki cocktail con Campari — sweetness + bitter balance.
45ml rum jamaicano + 22ml Campari + 45ml pineapple juice + 15ml lime + 15ml simple. Shake. Tiki mug crushed.
Modern Tiki classic post-revival. Jeffrey Morgenthaler perfeccionó receta.
wiki.art.cocktails.planter-s-punch-jamai: Planter's Punch cocktail nacional Jamaica. Rum + lime + sugar + soda + bitters. Tradicional plantation drink.
Origen siglo XIX plantation Jamaica. Myers's Rum brand secured recipe popularidad 1900s.
60ml dark rum Jamaican + 22ml lime + 22ml simple + soda + 3 dashes Angostura. Build. Mint + cherry.
1-2-3-4 ratio (1 sour, 2 sweet, 3 strong, 4 weak). Myers's tradicional rum.
wiki.art.cocktails.hurricane-new-orleans: Hurricane creado Pat O'Brien's NOLA 1940s durante WW2 rum surplus. Hurricane lamp glass icónico.
Pat O'Brien's NOLA 1940s. WW2 rum overflow + whiskey shortage = rum punch creativity.
60ml light rum + 60ml dark rum + 30ml passion fruit + 30ml lime + 15ml grenadine + 15ml orange. Shake. Hurricane glass.
Mardi Gras signature. Hurricane lamp glass + iconic visual.
Queen's Park Swizzle creado Queen's Park Hotel Port of Spain Trinidad 1920s. Rum swizzle + mint.
Queen's Park Hotel Trinidad 1920s. Trinidadian swizzle stick tradition.
60ml rum demerara + 22ml lime + 22ml simple + 8 mint leaves + 4 dashes Angostura. Swizzle crushed ice.
Swizzle stick autenticidad Trinidad. Angostura visual encima.
wiki.art.cocktails.test-pilot-tiki.title: Test Pilot
wiki.art.cocktails.test-pilot-tiki.descr: Test Pilot creado Don the Beachcomber para WW2 test pilots. Triple rum complex.
wiki.art.cocktails.test-pilot-tiki.histo: Donn Beach 1940s. Para aviadores aprobados pre-vuelo (irónicamente).
wiki.art.cocktails.test-pilot-tiki.recip: 45ml rum oscuro + 22ml rum blanco + 15ml lime + 15ml dry curaçao + 7.5ml falernum + 3 dashes Angostura + dash Pernod. Shake. Pebble ice.
wiki.art.cocktails.test-pilot-tiki.tips: Beachbum Berry decoded. Original Tiki canon.
wiki.art.cocktails.el-presidente-cuba.de: El Presidente cocktail nacional cubano pre-Prohibition era. Rum + vermut blanco + curaçao + grenadine.
wiki.art.cocktails.el-presidente-cuba.hi: 1920s Habana, nombrado por presidente Cubano Gerardo Machado. Pre-Prohibition US visitors drink.
wiki.art.cocktails.el-presidente-cuba.re: 60ml rum blanco + 30ml vermut blanco + 15ml dry curaçao + dash grenadine. Stir. Coupe.
wiki.art.cocktails.el-presidente-cuba.ti: Refinado, stirred. Versión gentleman pre-mojito ground zero.
wiki.art.cocktails.cuba-libre-history.de: Cuba Libre creado Habana 1900 post Spanish-American War. 'Por Cuba Libre' (free Cuba) toast.
wiki.art.cocktails.cuba-libre-history.hi: Habana 1900. US soldiers brought Coca-Cola, mixed con rum cubano + lime = 'toast a Cuba Libre'.
wiki.art.cocktails.cuba-libre-history.re: 60ml rum cubano + 15ml lime + Coca-Cola top. Build collins glass.
wiki.art.cocktails.cuba-libre-history.ti: Lime fresh squeezed. Coca-Cola original sweetness. Bacardí auténtico cubano (pre-1960).
wiki.art.cocktails.michelada-mexico.desc: Michelada cocktail mexicano de cerveza + lime + salsas + Worcestershire + Clamato (versión). Hangover cure.
wiki.art.cocktails.michelada-mexico.hist: Origen 1960s San Luis Potosí o Veracruz México. Beer-based cocktail nacional.
wiki.art.cocktails.michelada-mexico.reci: Cerveza Mexican lager + 30ml lime + Worcestershire + Tabasco + salt rim. Build chela glass.
wiki.art.cocktails.michelada-mexico.tips: Clamato versión clásica (con tomato juice). Hot sauce a gusto. Salt rim signature.
wiki.art.cocktails.paloma-mexico.title: Paloma
wiki.art.cocktails.paloma-mexico.descrip: Paloma cocktail mexicano más popular tras Margarita. Tequila + grapefruit soda + lime. Refrescante.
wiki.art.cocktails.paloma-mexico.history: México 1950s-60s. Don Javier Delgado Corona supposedly La Capilla Tequila town.
wiki.art.cocktails.paloma-mexico.recipe: 60ml tequila blanco + 15ml lime + pinch salt + grapefruit soda (Squirt o Ting) top. Build tall.
wiki.art.cocktails.paloma-mexico.tips: Squirt mexicano o Ting (Jamaican) standard. Salt rim opcional.
wiki.art.cocktails.caipirinha-brazil.des: Caipirinha cocktail nacional Brazil. Cachaça + lime + sugar muddled. Servido on the rocks.
wiki.art.cocktails.caipirinha-brazil.his: Brasil siglo XIX como medicina anti-Spanish flu. Cachaça campesina + lime + sugar.
wiki.art.cocktails.caipirinha-brazil.rec: 60ml cachaça + 1 lime entero cortado en wedges + 2 tsp sugar. Muddle lime + sugar. Add cachaça + ice. Stir.
wiki.art.cocktails.caipirinha-brazil.tip: Muddle lime (skin oil clave). Cachaça mejor 51, Leblon, Yaguara. NO Mojito (sin mint, sin soda).
wiki.art.cocktails.batida-brazil.title: Batida
wiki.art.cocktails.batida-brazil.descrip: Batida cocktail brasileño blendido de cachaça + fruta + condensed milk. Tropical, dessert-style.
wiki.art.cocktails.batida-brazil.history: Brasil siglo XX. Tropical fruit + cachaça invention.
wiki.art.cocktails.batida-brazil.recipe: 60ml cachaça + 90ml fruta puré (passion fruit, coco, melocotón) + 30ml condensed milk + ice. Blend.
wiki.art.cocktails.batida-brazil.tips: Variantes infinitas según fruta. Coco batida (Batida de Coco) más popular.
wiki.art.cocktails.pisco-punch-san-franc: Pisco Punch creado Duncan Nicol Bank Exchange SF 1900. Pisco + pineapple + lemon. Receta secreta.
Bank Exchange Saloon SF 1853. Duncan Nicol perfeccionó 1880s-1900s. Recipe lost on his death 1926.
60ml pisco peruvian + 30ml pineapple infused syrup + 22ml lemon + 22ml simple. Shake. Cup tall.
Recipe approximate (Wondrich rescued). Pineapple infusion key.
wiki.art.cocktails.chilcano-peru.title: Chilcano
wiki.art.cocktails.chilcano-peru.descrip: Chilcano cocktail peruano simple — pisco + ginger ale + lime + bitters. Refrescante.
wiki.art.cocktails.chilcano-peru.history: Lima Perú 1900s. Sailors brought ginger ale, Peruvian bartenders mezclaron con pisco local.
wiki.art.cocktails.chilcano-peru.recipe: 60ml pisco + 22ml lime + ginger ale top + 2 dashes Angostura. Build collins glass.
wiki.art.cocktails.chilcano-peru.tips: Real ginger beer mejor que ginger ale. Pisco quebranta o acholado standard.
wiki.art.cocktails.moscow-mule-copper-mu: Moscow Mule creado 1941 LA con vodka Smirnoff + ginger beer + lime. Copper mug marketing genius.
John Martin + Jack Morgan + Sophie Berezinski 1941 LA. Smirnoff vodka + Cock'n'Bull ginger beer + Berezinski's copper mugs.
60ml vodka + 15ml lime + ginger beer top. Build copper mug. Mint + lime wheel.
Copper mug conserva frío + visual signature. Real ginger beer obligado.
wiki.art.cocktails.dark-and-stormy-bermu: Dark and Stormy cocktail nacional Bermuda. Goslings Black Seal rum + ginger beer + lime. Trademark Goslings.
Bermuda 1880s. Sailors mezclaron Goslings dark rum local + ginger beer. Goslings trademark.
60ml Goslings Black Seal rum + ginger beer top + 15ml lime. Build collins.
Goslings rum legal trademark (sin Goslings = 'Dark 'N Stormy' technically incorrect).
wiki.art.cocktails.bloody-mary-history.d: Bloody Mary inventado Fernand Petiot Harry's Bar Paris 1921. Brunch standard mundial.
wiki.art.cocktails.bloody-mary-history.h: Petiot 1921 Paris. Llegado al St. Regis NYC 1934 con nombre 'Red Snapper' (Vanderbilt vetó 'Bloody Mary').
wiki.art.cocktails.bloody-mary-history.r: 45ml vodka + 90ml tomato juice + Worcestershire + Tabasco + lime + salt + pepper. Roll/build. Celery.
wiki.art.cocktails.bloody-mary-history.t: Roll (no shake) mantiene tomato structure. Garnish creative (celery, bacon, shrimp).
wiki.art.cocktails.bloody-mary-vs-bloody: Bloody Caesar = canadiense Bloody Mary con Clamato (tomato + clam juice). Walter Chell Calgary 1969.
Walter Chell Calgary 1969. Bloody Caesar = national drink Canada con Clamato.
45ml vodka + Clamato + Worcestershire + Tabasco + salt rim. Build.
Clamato (clam + tomato juice) diferencia. Más popular Canada que USA.
wiki.art.cocktails.penicillin-sam-ross.d: Penicillin inventado Sam Ross Milk & Honey NYC 2005. Scotch + honey + ginger + lime. Modern classic.
wiki.art.cocktails.penicillin-sam-ross.h: Sam Ross Milk & Honey 2005. Receta para 'cure for all ills' — penicillin metaphor.
wiki.art.cocktails.penicillin-sam-ross.r: 60ml blended Scotch + 22ml lemon + 22ml honey-ginger syrup. Shake. Float 7.5ml Islay smoky Scotch.
wiki.art.cocktails.penicillin-sam-ross.t: Islay float (Laphroaig, Ardbeg) signature smoke. Honey-ginger syrup key (fresh).
wiki.art.cocktails.paper-plane-recipe.de: Paper Plane inventado Sam Ross para Toby Maloney Violet Hour Chicago 2007. Bourbon + Aperol + Amaro Meletti + lemon.
wiki.art.cocktails.paper-plane-recipe.hi: Sam Ross M&H 2007 para Toby Maloney. M.I.A. song 'Paper Planes' inspiration.
wiki.art.cocktails.paper-plane-recipe.re: 22ml bourbon + 22ml Aperol + 22ml Amaro Meletti + 22ml lemon. Equal parts. Shake. Coupe.
wiki.art.cocktails.paper-plane-recipe.ti: Equal parts perfect balance. Amaro Meletti specific (no Nonino o otros).
wiki.art.cocktails.gold-rush-cocktail.de: Gold Rush inventado T.J. Siegal Milk & Honey NYC 2002. Bourbon + honey + lemon. Sour template moderno.
wiki.art.cocktails.gold-rush-cocktail.hi: T.J. Siegal M&H 2002. Sasha Petraske refinement. Modern simple classic.
wiki.art.cocktails.gold-rush-cocktail.re: 60ml bourbon + 22ml lemon + 22ml honey syrup. Shake. Coupe up.
wiki.art.cocktails.gold-rush-cocktail.ti: Honey syrup (1:1 honey + hot water). Bourbon balanced fruity.
wiki.art.cocktails.naked-and-famous.desc: Naked and Famous inventado Joaquin Simó Death & Co NYC 2011. Mezcal + Yellow Chartreuse + Aperol + lime. Equal parts.
wiki.art.cocktails.naked-and-famous.hist: Joaquin Simó Death & Co 2011. Cross entre Last Word + Paper Plane.
wiki.art.cocktails.naked-and-famous.reci: 22ml mezcal + 22ml Yellow Chartreuse + 22ml Aperol + 22ml lime. Shake. Coupe.
wiki.art.cocktails.naked-and-famous.tips: Equal parts. Smoky-sweet-bitter-tart balance perfecto. Mezcal joven joven.
wiki.art.cocktails.trinidad-sour.title: Trinidad Sour
wiki.art.cocktails.trinidad-sour.descrip: Trinidad Sour inventado Giuseppe Gonzalez Clover Club Brooklyn 2009. 1.5oz Angostura main ingredient — crazy.
wiki.art.cocktails.trinidad-sour.history: Giuseppe Gonzalez 2009. Reinvented bitters as main spirit, not modifier.
wiki.art.cocktails.trinidad-sour.recipe: 45ml Angostura + 22ml rye + 22ml lemon + 30ml orgeat. Shake. Coupe.
wiki.art.cocktails.trinidad-sour.tips: Angostura as primary spirit (no dash) signature. Orgeat balance key.
wiki.art.cocktails.jasmine-cocktail.desc: Jasmine cocktail inventado Paul Harrington Townhouse Berkeley 1990s. Gin + Campari + lemon + Cointreau.
wiki.art.cocktails.jasmine-cocktail.hist: Paul Harrington 1990s. Jasmine flower color (rose pink).
wiki.art.cocktails.jasmine-cocktail.reci: 45ml gin + 7.5ml Campari + 22ml lemon + 15ml Cointreau. Shake. Coupe.
wiki.art.cocktails.jasmine-cocktail.tips: Color rose pink signature. Más sweet que Negroni típico.
wiki.art.cocktails.gin-basil-smash.title: Gin Basil Smash
wiki.art.cocktails.gin-basil-smash.descr: Gin Basil Smash inventado Jörg Meyer Le Lion Hamburg 2008. Gin + basil + lemon + sugar.
wiki.art.cocktails.gin-basil-smash.histo: Jörg Meyer Hamburg 2008. 'Gin Pesto' nickname. Modern German classic.
wiki.art.cocktails.gin-basil-smash.recip: 60ml gin + 22ml lemon + 22ml simple + 12 basil leaves. Hard shake. Double strain. DOF cubed.
wiki.art.cocktails.gin-basil-smash.tips: Basil leaves bruise para oils. Double strain (no green leaves).
wiki.art.cocktails.tommy-s-margarita-vs-: Tommy's Margarita = Margarita SIN Cointreau, con agave syrup. Julio Bermejo Tommy's SF 1990s.
Julio Bermejo Tommy's Restaurant SF 1990s. Pioneer modern agave-Margarita.
60ml tequila + 30ml lime + 15ml agave syrup. Shake. Rocks (no salt rim).
100% agave tequila only. Sin Cointreau más pure tequila taste. Tommy's SF standard.
wiki.art.cocktails.margarita-history.des: Margarita origen disputado — Carlos 'Danny' Herrera 1938, Margarita Sames 1948, Daisy variation. Daisy = Margarita en español.
wiki.art.cocktails.margarita-history.his: Multiple claims 1930s-1940s Mexico. Más probable evolution del Daisy (Brandy Daisy → Tequila Daisy → Margarita).
wiki.art.cocktails.margarita-history.rec: 60ml tequila + 30ml lime + 30ml Cointreau. Shake. Salt rim (optional). Coupe.
wiki.art.cocktails.margarita-history.tip: Cointreau standard, no triple sec barato. Lime fresh. Embury 8:3:2.
wiki.art.cocktails.margarita-tommy-s-ver: Margarita Tommy's = sin Cointreau, con agave syrup. Versión más pure tequila para 100% agave.
Julio Bermejo Tommy's Restaurant SF 1990s. Modernizó Margarita para 100% agave tequila.
60ml 100% agave tequila + 30ml lime + 15ml agave syrup (1:1 agave nectar:water). Shake.
100% agave tequila essential. Versión preferida bartenders modern.
wiki.art.beer.ale-pale.title: Pale Ale
wiki.art.beer.ale-pale.description: Pale Ale estilo amber-pale top fermented ale. Bitter balanceado.
wiki.art.beer.ale-pale.characteristics: Hops bitter + malt sweet balance. 4-6% ABV.
wiki.art.beer.ale-ipa.title: IPA
wiki.art.beer.ale-ipa.description: IPA originalmente para British India 1700s. Hop-forward intense.
wiki.art.beer.ale-double-ipa.title: Double IPA
wiki.art.beer.ale-double-ipa.description: Double IPA = imperial IPA con doble dosis hops + malt. 8-10% ABV.
wiki.art.beer.ale-double-ipa.tips: Pliny the Elder Russian River legendary.
wiki.art.beer.ale-session-ipa.title: Session IPA
wiki.art.beer.ale-session-ipa.descriptio: Session IPA todo el hop flavor sin alto ABV. 4-5% ABV.
wiki.art.beer.ale-session-ipa.characteri: Same hops as IPA, less malt.
wiki.art.beer.ale-amber.title: Amber Ale
wiki.art.beer.ale-amber.description: Amber Ale balanced ale con caramel malt notes. 4-6% ABV.
wiki.art.beer.ale-brown.title: Brown Ale
wiki.art.beer.ale-brown.description: Brown Ale top-fermented con chocolate/nutty malts. UK origin.
wiki.art.beer.ale-stout.title: Stout
wiki.art.beer.ale-stout.description: Stout dark ale con roasted barley/malt. Coffee, chocolate.
wiki.art.beer.ale-imperial-stout.title: Imperial Stout
wiki.art.beer.ale-imperial-stout.descrip: Imperial Stout creado para Catalina la Grande Rusia. 8-12% ABV intenso.
wiki.art.beer.ale-porter.title: Porter
wiki.art.beer.ale-porter.description: Porter London 1700s para market porters. Dark, malty, less roasted que stout.
wiki.art.beer.ale-baltic-porter.title: Baltic Porter
wiki.art.beer.ale-baltic-porter.descript: Baltic Porter lager-fermented (unusual). 7-9% ABV. Baltic region tradition.
wiki.art.beer.ale-saison.title: Saison
wiki.art.beer.ale-saison.description: Saison Belgian farmhouse ale. Spicy yeast, dry, refreshing.
wiki.art.beer.ale-belgian-strong.title: Belgian Strong Ale
wiki.art.beer.ale-belgian-strong.descrip: Belgian Strong Ale high-alcohol abadía tradition. 7-12% ABV.
wiki.art.beer.ale-tripel.title: Tripel
wiki.art.beer.ale-tripel.description: Tripel Belgian abadía strong pale ale. Triple malt. 8-9% ABV.
wiki.art.beer.ale-quadrupel.title: Quadrupel
wiki.art.beer.ale-quadrupel.description: Quadrupel highest abadía strong dark ale. 10-13% ABV.
wiki.art.beer.ale-dubbel.title: Dubbel
wiki.art.beer.ale-dubbel.description: Dubbel Belgian abadía amber-brown ale. 6-7% ABV.
wiki.art.beer.ale-witbier.title: Witbier
wiki.art.beer.ale-witbier.description: Witbier Belgian white ale con coriander + orange peel.
wiki.art.beer.ale-flemish-red.title: Flemish Red
wiki.art.beer.ale-flemish-red.descriptio: Flemish Red ale aged sour oak barrels. Belgium West Flanders.
wiki.art.beer.ale-lambic.title: Lambic
wiki.art.beer.ale-lambic.description: Lambic Belgian spontaneous fermentation wild yeasts.
